# JuneGiri Farms

> JuneGiri Farms is a family-run farm house and homestay at the edge of Rajaji National Park near Rishikesh, Uttarakhand, India. It offers forest-view rooms, a Garhwali/Pahadi farm kitchen with all meals included, and curated Himalayan trips (Char Dham Yatra, treks, Rishikesh adventures). Founded in December 2020 by Geeta "Geetu" Payal and Vignesh. Rated 5.0★ on Google (68 reviews). Booking is direct, via WhatsApp.

## Key pages
- [Stay — rooms & rates](https://junegirifarms.com/stay): Three room types (Jungle View, Neelkanth Stream View, Farm Stay Suite) from ₹2,500 per person/night, all meals included.
- [Plan your stay](https://junegirifarms.com/plan): Rates, activities, and how to book in two minutes.
- [Stay Pass — founding membership](https://junegirifarms.com/stay-pass): A one-time prepaid membership giving free 2-night stays, member rates and a price-lock, with no annual fees and no lock-in.
- [Char Dham Yatra & treks](https://junegirifarms.com/yatra): Guided pilgrimages and Himalayan treks.
- [Rishikesh adventures](https://junegirifarms.com/adventure): Rafting, bungee, cliff jumping, Rajaji jeep safari.
- [About the founders](https://junegirifarms.com/about): The story of Geetu & Vignesh and JuneGiri since 2020.
- [FAQ](https://junegirifarms.com/faq)
- [Contact](https://junegirifarms.com/contact)

## Key facts
- Location: Maral Village, Yamkeshwar, Pauri Garhwal, Uttarakhand 249304 — at the edge of Rajaji National Park, ~7 km from Neelkanth Mahadev Temple.
- Getting there: nearest railway station Haridwar (45 km); nearest airport Dehradun Jolly Grant (35 km). Pickup available.
- Rates: rooms from ₹2,500 per person per night (plus GST), including three vegetarian Pahadi meals a day.
- Family-run since December 2020. Pet-friendly. 5.0★ on Google (68 reviews).
- Booking: WhatsApp +91 98738 97652 or email junegirifarms@gmail.com. A 30% deposit holds dates; balance on arrival.
